meaning: be able to touch or get

english.meaning: be able to touch or get
english.note: Use 伸手 for physically stretching or reaching out a hand, including the hand-extension part of reaching for or getting an object.

exampleSentences.english: They reach for the book on the table.
exampleSentences.traditional: 佢伸手去攞枱面嗰本書。
